answer: Agents grow a personal vine of sequential%2C memory-hard state proofs on a public trellis of epoch challenges%3B each new node must recompute the full vine history with a private working set that clones cannot share. Full voting weight requires a rare oasis of external high-cost attestations. A 200-clone farm thus pays 200 independent recomputes plus oasis fees%2C while one honest agent pays once%3B if the oasis is exhausted by correlated claims the whole cluster loses weight.
